svg.text: SG90 + Limit Switch → ESP8266 (NodeMCU) → ULN2003 Driver → 28BYJ-48 Stepper
USB — powers the board + uploads firmware
(does NOT power the motor or servo)
(≥ 1 A — now feeding the ULN2003 AND the SG90,
Wiring reference (must match the firmware’s pin definitions):
ESP8266 D3 (GPIO0) → SG90 feeder servo signal
Avoid GPIO2 / GPIO15 / GPIO16 (board boot-mode pins) for anything new — D1, D2, D5, D6, D3, D7 used here are all safe.
D3 (GPIO0) is a boot pin too, but safe here since it only ever drives OUTPUT (the servo) — D7 has no boot role at all, ideal for the switch INPUT.
